enrichment.summary: On the Measure N Commission's recommendation, the Board is approving a 2021-22 budget change for Oakland High School that moves $3,500 from facility rental to supplies and materials. Measure N is the voter-approved College and Career Readiness for All Act. The text says there is no impact because the school no longer needs the full amount.

items.group: Measure N Commission - March 1, 2022 - Jason Gumataotao, Chairperson

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays HERTZ Environmental up to $21,500 for stormwater planning at Claremont Middle School project
enrichment.summary: The district is hiring HERTZ Environmental, Inc. to write a Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan, inspect the site, and handle reporting, training and permit tracking for the Claremont Middle School Multipurpose Room and Kitchen Project. The limit is $21,500, which includes up to $3,000 for additional services. Work is scheduled to run from March 24, 2022 to October 31, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement – HERTZ Environmental, Inc. – Claremont Middle School Multipurpose Room & Kitchen Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.summary: The district is hiring HERTZ Environmental, Inc. to write a Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan, inspect the site, and handle reporting, training and permit tracking for the Laurel Child Development Center Replacement Project.
